name: styles
title: ANSI escape sequences of crayon styles

origin.description: The open and close sequences of every named style.
origin.details: Builtin styles are entered when the package loads. make_style(name = ...) adds a name, and drop_style() removes one. Each element has open and close, and a color style also has a palette index.
origin.value: A named list of open and close sequences.

translation.description: The open and close sequences of every named style.
translation.details: A dict in the builtin order, then any names added later. Each value has open, close, and palette. palette is None for bold, italic, and the other non-color styles.
